cases.name: Rebecca Ruth Callahan
cases.about: Please send information about her life, dreams or interests to shecounted@gmail.com
cases.narrative:
On Mother's Day, 4/12/2002, Rebecca's torso was found in a ravine near Cajalco Rd. and La Sierra Ave., in the Lake Matthews area of Riverside County. Her head and limbs had been cut off. She was identified through her tattoos. On 4/18/2002, her legs, wrapped in trash bags, were on Gavilan Rd., 1/2 mile south of Mulitview Rd. in Riverside County, a rural road a few miles from the ravine.

Her head and arms are still missing
